title: updateCustomerField request
description: Set one or more attribute values on a customer. Writes the classification store. Each customFields entry needs a customFieldId that already exists (create it first via createField) and a value. The reply echoes updatedFields with oldValue/newValue. QUIRK: an unknown customFieldId does NOT return an E### code — response_code comes back as the free-text '<id> is Invalid, ' with empty response_code_desc and null updatedFields; detect success by a leading 'S'. Errors: E135 (customer not found), E151 (customFields empty).
